name: muapi-talking-baby-video
tagline_zh: 上传宝宝照片，选套小戏服，输入台词，AI 让萌娃开口说段子。自带网红滤镜和字幕节奏，连眨眼都像真在演。
tagline_en: Upload a baby pic, pick a costume, type lines—AI makes the tot talk with viral flair, winks and all.
desc_en: Create a viral-style video of a talking baby with custom costumes and scripts.
why_zh: 同类只会换脸，它连表情、口型和服装都一起生成，像真在演，不是贴图。
why_en: Others just swap faces; this one syncs expressions, lip-move, and outfit into one believable performance.
